summary.text: Kwani O'Pharrow is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 11 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is a U.S. Navy veteran and former New York City police detective.

paragraphs.text: O'Pharrow served in the U.S. Navy from 1990 to 1994.

His career experience includes working for the New York City Police Department, co-founding Cops N' Kids Long Island, Inc., overseeing Student & Community Relations Officers, and working as a New York State Department of Criminal Justice law enforcement instructor.
O'Pharrow assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Kimberly Jean-Pierre.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Higher Education, Local Governments, Real Property Taxation, Social Services, and Veterans' Affairs.
